invariants: An exact known live source is cloned without listing or inspecting persistence; a persisted exact source is listed and inspected once, with the same signal and compatible immutable headers.
A live publication after inspection wins; exact loaded outputs detach header and raw events, while operational errors retain literal name/code/message and original cause.
Title batches deduplicate in first-occurrence order, use one persistence listing, and isolate per-id operational failures while preserving known live results.
Persisted title inspections use the configured safe integer concurrency and project each completed source before a worker claims its next id; batch results retain no full log.
Cancellation stops queued inspection admission, drains already-started inspections, then rejects with the exact signal reason.
Title values are immutable detached snapshots; batch headers remain caller-owned clones. Public readSession/readTitleSnapshot/readTitle and canonical JSONL none/zstd consumers stay cold.
identity: Exact Session headers, original error/cause and signal identity, first-occurrence result identity, immutable title snapshot and runtime root/module are retained.
ownership: The source resolves one live or persisted cut; bounded workers own started inspections through signal cancellation, and project logs immediately without retaining them in batch output.
ordering: Live sources project first; one listing precedes unresolved inspection; completed projection precedes admission of the next queued id; started workers settle before abort escapes.
errors: Nineteen literal source/native observations freeze failure names, codes, messages and identities. ThrownValueError remains only the non-Error rejection carrier.
cancellation: Signal abort before source work performs no listing; controlled batch cancellation preserves exact reason and observed drain. Arbitrary Python task cancellation is not certified.
adaptation: Python supports integral floats in configuration as JavaScript safe integer Numbers; booleans, fractions, non-finite values, strings and unsafe values are refused. Deep-freeze represents original immutable title values.
open_questions: Current bounded qualification is recorded in rc1_review. These nineteen observations use controlled persistence listing/inspection/failure/drain seams; four canonical JSONL none/zstd consumers separately cover real cold reads and pre-abort. Full FTS, filters/event tracing, long history, all title source variants, provider replacement epochs, arbitrary Task cancellation, complete Web/profile and deferred Win7 remain open.

rc1_review.scope: Current finite executable provider/consumer corpora, original-browser and extracted observations in the single full receipt. Historical alpha evidence remains historical; no inventory-wide parity, arbitrary ABI/history, paid-provider or Win7 certification.
